gloss: not at all, not in the least

definitions.gloss: not at all, not in the least
definitions.explanation: Used with negative verbs to emphasize that something is completely absent or does not happen at all.

examples.japanese: {少|すこ}しも⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{少|すこ}しも⟦{変|か}わっていない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
{少|すこ}しも⟦{気|き}にしていない→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm not bothered in the slightest.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{少|すこ}しも⟦{面白|おもしろ}くなかった→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧。
examples.english: That person's story was not interesting in the least.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}しても→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧{少|すこ}しも⟦{分|わ}かって→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦もらえなくて→もらう：00520_morau⟧、⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how many times I explained, they didn't understand at all, and I was at a loss.

notes:
{少|すこ}しも is always followed by a negative, of a verb or an adjective: {少|すこ}しも⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧, {少|すこ}しも⟦{面白|おもしろ}くない→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧...⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: not at all — the most common in speech
- ⟦{全|まった}く→全く：02363_mattaku⟧...⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: not at all — emphatic, common in writing
- ⟦ちっとも→ちっとも：01663_chittomo⟧...⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: not at all — casual
- {少|すこ}しも stresses that not even a small amount is there

WATCH OUT:
For "a little" in an affirmative sentence, use ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧ without ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ (I understand a little).
